what_happened: Nationwide shutdown from 5 Jan 2022 to 10 Jan 2022, with short windows of access each day
Fixed and mobile internet cut on 25 Oct 2021 after the coup, services began returning 18 Nov 2021
Nationwide shutdown from 18 Jul 2024, broadband back 24 Jul, mobile back 28 Jul, second nationwide cut 4 to 5 Aug
Nationwide shutdown from 29 Oct 2025, general access restored 3 Nov 2025
Connectivity fell sharply on 17 Jun 2025 and was almost completely blocked from 18 Jun, services restored 25 Jun 2025
Blackout from 8 Jan 2026 with partial return in late January, then a cut of more than 99 percent from 28 Feb 2026 that lasted past the end of the quarter
Mobile networks cut 4pm to midnight from 21 Sep to 3 Oct 2022 and again on 8, 12 and 15 Oct, regional outages, app stores and messaging apps blocked. Fixed line mostly stayed up
Coup on 1 Feb 2021, 30 hour nationwide cut on 6 to 7 Feb, nightly cuts from 15 Feb to 28 Apr, all mobile data off from 15 Mar, then whitelisting
Mobile internet suspended from 9 May 2023, restored 12 May 2023. Fixed line stayed up
